articleBodyHtml:
Birthday Celebrations and Gratitude

The speaker acknowledges the difficulty of being four years old and expresses gratitude for birthday wishes and support.

The speaker expresses gratitude for support and wishes a happy birthday to Tencho.

The speaker expresses anticipation for the birthday celebration.

The speaker thanks the audience, expresses a desire to ride alpacas, and asks about their fluffiness, intending to research it.

The speaker thanked the person for the birthday wishes and admitted to a poor delivery.
